name: K-12 STEM Future Corps (INL high school internship)
what_you_do: Work six weeks at Idaho National Laboratory. Start with a week of orientation and job skills. Then rotate through facilities doing hands-on work like machining, welding, drafting and heavy equipment. End with a project and a talk.
who_can_apply: 11th or 12th graders who have taken a career and technical education (CTE) course. The fact sheet says students come from schools that have partnered with INL. Ask your school if it is a partner.
pay_detail: Paid. The pay rate is not stated on the fact sheet. Transportation, food and safety gear are provided.
duration: 6 weeks, mid June to early August
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted. The fact sheet is dated January 2025 and says the program intends to run from mid June to early August.
how_to_apply: Send a resume, an unofficial transcript and the application. INL checks that you are eligible, then interviews some applicants, then runs a background check. Ask your school CTE teacher or email russell.campbell@inl.gov.
notes: This card is based on the INL fact sheet dated January 2025. Confirm current dates at stem.inl.gov. Only students from partner schools can apply.
